label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Priya,

First, stop. You are not getting thrown under the bus. I’m not going to Greg with “Priya did it.” I’ll tell him what he actually needs to know: we had stale draft language in the questionnaire library, Q14 didn’t get checked against the trust page, and we’re fixing it today. He’s going to be mad no matter what — I’ll handle him. That’s on me, not you.

You’ve been great on this account. I still think about September when the route import broke and you stayed until 9pm rebuilding their demo environment. I’m not hanging you out to dry over one copy-paste. And honestly, the library is a mess — nobody owns it. This isn’t just a Priya problem.

I won’t pretend this isn’t a big one for me. Brazos is 186k ARR on a three-year term, I’ve been working it since February, and it’s my biggest deal of the year. I already told my wife we’d finally do the Big Bend trip off this commission. But I really do think this is fixable if we’re honest and fast. Dana seems strict but fair.

Here’s what I need from you:

- Tonight, fix Q14 with the real Type I status and the Jan 31 audit window close. Send it to me first, not Dana. Don’t send anything to her until I’ve seen it.
- Thursday at 2, join the call with Dana and their legal. Marcus from our security team can be on it too. He says we can give them a bridge letter from the auditor, so I want us ready to talk through that.
- The Type II report is expected by March. That’s the story: Type I in hand, Type II in progress, window closes Jan 31, bridge letter available.

Don’t beat yourself up. Let’s get Q14 fixed tonight and go into Thursday solid. I’ve got your back.

Jordan
